style: Minimal ivory-and-gold corporation cards. Creature of Habit is the shared style reference.

jobs.name: Creature of Habit
jobs.description: Played the same corporation in two rounds of one tournament.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimalist achievement emblem for the center of an existing game badge, part of a consistent Corporation Loyalty family.
Style: smooth raised ivory enamel with narrow warm-gold rims, shallow polished bevels, thin dark edges, soft highlights from upper left. Front-on orthographic pictogram. Broad solid shapes, no texture or engraved details. Recognizable at small sizes.
The corporation-card motif is a simple upright rounded rectangle, ivory face with a narrow gold border. No card text, no game statistics, no tiny markings. Keep any symbol on a card large and simple.
Composition: compact and balanced, centered on a square transparent canvas with at least 15 percent clear margin; every object fully visible. Only the described objects.
Background: actual transparent alpha PNG. Fully transparent outside objects and in every gap. No backdrop, no black fill, no glow, no haze, no cast shadow.
Avoid: outer badge frame, extra objects, background disc, laurels, scenery, text, letters, numerals, logos of real corporations, presentation sheet.
Subject: Exactly TWO equal-size upright corporation cards standing side by side with a small clear gap. Each card bears the EXACT SAME large solid gold hexagon centered on its ivory face. Both cards have identical shapes, colors and symbols; no overlap. Only two cards.
